description: Reference-first build — 'show me what you like, I'll build it.' Give a reference you LIKE (a public site URL via reference_url, and/or a curated library id via reference_id from search_references) plus what YOU are building, and get back a matching StandOut direction, a reference-backed build plan, and the next call for section code. This is the front door for building from an EXAMPLE instead of a text brief: Standout reads the URL server-side for its semantic signal (title, headings, copy) and folds it into the direction match. Note: pixel-level palette/type extraction from an image is not yet supported (that is the Phase 2 vision pass) — for now it matches on the page's text/structure plus the curated library. Pass reference_id to anchor on an exact curated reference.

business.description: What YOU are building (not the reference), e.g. 'booking site for a Fiji dive shop'

direction.description: Optional StandOut direction id to force, e.g. terminal-grade

industry.description: Industry or category, e.g. developer tool, restaurant, law firm

reference_id.description: Or a curated reference id from search_references to anchor the match on

reference_url.description: Public URL of a site whose style you like. Standout reads it server-side for its semantic signal.

vibe.description: Desired feel, e.g. premium, technical, warm, playful

name: build_from_reference
